1. (Currently amended) A loading ramp, said loading ramp comprising: a support structure having a mounting member, said mounting member being compatible with a truck having a bed such that said support structure is adapted to be removably mounted to the truck; a first gradient member secured to said support structure, said first gradient member defining a first surface, a proximate end, and a distal end, the proximate end being opposite the distal end with respect to the first surface, the proximate end being proximate the bed of the truck when said support structure is mounted to the truck, the first surface being structured to support a small vehicle; and a second gradient member secured to said first gradient member at the distal end such that said second gradient member pivots at the distal end to the extent that said second gradient member is capable of an up position and a down position, said second gradient member defining a second surface structured to support the small vehicle, said first gradient member and said second gradient member defining an inclined surface between a ground surface and the bed of the truck when said second gradient member is at the down position and said support structure is mounted to the truck, the inclined surface being traversable by the small vehicle, said loading ramp being carried by the truck when said second gradient member is at the up position and said support structure is mounted to the truck, said loading ramp not limiting the storage space provided by the truck when said loading ramp is carried by the truck.

2. (Currently amended) The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein said loading ramp makes available storage space provided by the truck otherwise occupied when said loading ramp and the small vehicle are carried by the truck, and wherein said second gradient member is at the up position.

3. (Currently amended) The loading ramp of Claim 2 wherein said loading ramp supports at least a portion of the small vehicle when said loading ramp and the small vehicle are carried by the truck and said second gradient member is at the up position.

4. (Original) The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein said mounting member is compatible with a receiver-type hitch.

5. (Original) The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein said support structure is adjustable such that the proximate end of said first gradient member is proximate the bed of the truck when said support structure is mounted to the truck regardless of the size of the truck.

6. (Original) The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein the proximate end of said first gradient member rests against a rear bumper of the truck when said support structure is mounted to the truck.

7. (Original) The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein the proximate end of said first gradient member rests against the bed of the truck when said support structure is mounted to the truck.

8. (Currently amended) The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein the first surface defined by said first gradient member includes a plurality of beams __extending longitudinally between the proximate end and the distal end__.

9. (Currently amended) The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein the first surface defined by said first gradient member includes a solid surface __that is non-perforated__.

10. (Currently amended) The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein the first surface defined by said first gradient member includes a porous surface __having perforations for drainage__.

11. (Currently amended) The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein the second surface defined by said second gradient member includes a plurality of beams __extending longitudinally between a proximate end and a distal end of said second gradient member__.

12. (Currently amended) The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein the second surface defined by said second gradient member includes a solid surface __that is non-perforated__.

13. (Currently amended) The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein the second surface defined by said second gradient member includes a porous surface __having perforations for drainage__.

14. (Currently amended) The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein said second gradient member comprises a plurality of separate gradient members __each pivoting independently at the distal end of said first gradient member__.

15. (Currently amended) The loading ramp of Claim 14 wherein said plurality of separate gradient members includes a left gradient member and a right gradient member __positioned on opposite sides of a longitudinal centerline of said first gradient member__.

16. (Currently amended) The loading ramp of Claim 15 wherein the distance between said left gradient member and said right gradient member is adjustable __by means of a sliding mechanism that allows said left and right gradient members to move laterally relative to each other__.

17. (Currently amended) The loading ramp of Claim 14 wherein said plurality of separate gradient members includes a left gradient member, a right gradient member, and a center gradient member __positioned between said left and right gradient members__.

18. (Currently amended) The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein said first gradient member includes a first rail and a second rail running longitudinally between the proximate end and the distal end, said first rail being disposed opposite said second rail with respect to the first surface, __said first and second rails being spaced apart to define a gap therebetween and being rigidly connected to prevent relative motion__.

19. (Currently amended) The loading ramp of Claim 1 further comprising a mechanical device, said mechanical device moving said second gradient member between the up position and down position, __said mechanical device including a hydraulic cylinder or pneumatic actuator__.

20. (Currently amended) The loading ramp of Claim 1 further comprising a locking member, said locking member locking said second gradient member at the up position, __said locking member preventing said second gradient member from pivoting downward when the loading ramp is being carried by the truck__.

21. (Original) The loading ramp of Claim 20 wherein said locking member includes a beam secured to said first gradient member and said second gradient member.

22. (Currently amended) The loading ramp of Claim 20 wherein said locking member includes a chain secured to said first gradient member and said second gradient member, __said chain having a predetermined length that limits the downward pivot of said second gradient member__.

23. (Currently amended) The loading ramp of Claim 20 wherein said locking member includes a mechanical device __selected from the group consisting of a latch, a pin, and a bolt__.
